scope: Phase 059 Step 34.2 all test/demo assertions, tolerances, I/O paths, and untested branches
authority_boundary: Static test/demo evidence audit. Runtime results are Step 34.3; internal regression is not theory or experimental validation.

findings.title: All thirty files contain zero Python assert statements
findings.claim: The 12 test-role and 18 demo-role blobs contain no ast.Assert node.
findings.implication: Only explicit exit codes or uncaught exceptions can enforce failure.

findings.title: Regression verify enforces bit equality on generated arrays
findings.claim: verify compares each current output array with the golden array using np.array_equal and exits nonzero on mismatch.
findings.implication: This protects one numerical baseline but proves neither physical correctness nor experimental agreement.

source_evidence.source_line: eq = np.array_equal(out[k], gold[k])   # bit-exact, NOT allclose

findings.title: Area conservation is printed but not gated
findings.claim: The regression harness computes equilibrium area and prints its ratio without including it in all_ok.
findings.implication: The documented area check can fail while the regression process exits successfully.

findings.title: Capture mode overwrites the golden baseline
findings.claim: capture writes all current outputs directly to GOLD.
findings.implication: Running capture before adjudicating a change can normalize a defect into the baseline.

findings.title: Golden path is hard-coded while only code path is overridable
findings.claim: ANODEFIT_CODE can redirect the module, but GOLD remains an absolute Windows path.
findings.implication: The harness is not hermetic and cannot be executed reliably on another host without controlled source rewriting or path emulation.

findings.title: Sample tests are report-only visualizations
findings.claim: The sample script explicitly labels console verification as report only and always prints DONE.
findings.implication: Finite values and peak counts are not asserted.

source_evidence.source_line: # ---- console verification (report only; no physics assertion) ----

findings.title: LCO heat demo has no numeric failure condition
findings.claim: The demo prints expected values and a validation-done banner without an enforced comparison.
findings.implication: It demonstrates execution and plotting only.

findings.title: Graph suite finite, parity, area, and dictionary checks are print-only
findings.claim: The suite collects finite flags and prints errors/ratios/expected labels without sys.exit or assert.
findings.implication: A false finite flag or wrong ratio still exits zero absent an exception.

findings.title: Shape and area verdict in plot_dqdv is print-only
findings.claim: The plotted shape predicate and area tolerance are passed to print rather than an assertion.
findings.implication: A false verdict does not fail the process.

findings.title: Thirty versioned blobs reduce to five unchanged logic families
findings.claim: After normalizing version/path-only strings, each of the five harness families has the same AST across six releases.
findings.implication: v1.0.16 n(T) and v1.0.18.2 Einstein additions did not receive new dedicated harness logic.

findings.claim: The complete test/demo corpus contains no n_T1 or theta_E token.
findings.implication: The two headline post-v1.0.15 features are absent from these standard tests and demos.

findings.title: Critical production-code branches are untested
findings.claim: No harness enforces nonmonotone/reversal chronology, finite-window prehistory, direct-L_V zero-current behavior, missing n/w fallback, Q-cell unit conversion, or Einstein Tref positivity.
findings.implication: The static code blockers from Step 34.1 can pass the historical suites.

findings.title: No public experimental dataset is loaded
findings.claim: All inputs are synthetic linspace arrays and shipped literal dictionaries; there is no measured-data read path.
findings.implication: The corpus cannot establish material validity, doped high-voltage LCO accuracy, or graphite/Si transferability.

findings.title: PASS, DONE, and VALIDATION labels exceed enforced evidence
findings.claim: Several scripts print completion or validation banners even when their numeric checks are report-only.
findings.implication: Historical handovers can misread successful execution as scientific validation.

findings.title: Regression comparison ignores extra golden arrays
findings.claim: verify iterates current output keys only and never requires the golden key set to match exactly.
findings.implication: Stale or extra golden arrays do not fail the gate.
